<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>body{margin:0}</style></head><body><svg width="1080" height="600" viewBox="0 0 1080 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<rect width="1080" height="600" fill="#eef4fb"/>
<!-- concentric rings -->
<circle cx="430" cy="300" r="230" fill="#4d7ec2" opacity="0.18"/>
<circle cx="430" cy="300" r="230" fill="none" stroke="#4d7ec2" stroke-width="5"/>
<circle cx="430" cy="300" r="160" fill="#5b8fd6" opacity="0.3"/>
<circle cx="430" cy="300" r="160" fill="none" stroke="#3e6aa8" stroke-width="5"/>
<circle cx="430" cy="300" r="95" fill="#0f2440"/>
<!-- AI chip -->
<g>
<rect x="382" y="252" width="96" height="96" rx="14" fill="#5b8fd6" stroke="#7fe0ff" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="430" y="295" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">AI</text>
<text x="430" y="325" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC" font-size="18" fill="#dbe7f5">Claude</text>
<g stroke="#7fe0ff" stroke-width="4">
<polyline points="392,252 392,232"/><polyline points="418,252 418,232"/><polyline points="444,252 444,232"/><polyline points="470,252 470,232"/>
<polyline points="392,348 392,368"/><polyline points="418,348 418,368"/><polyline points="444,348 444,368"/><polyline points="470,348 470,368"/>
<polyline points="382,262 362,262"/><polyline points="382,288 362,288"/><polyline points="382,314 362,314"/><polyline points="382,340 362,340"/>
<polyline points="478,262 498,262"/><polyline points="478,288 498,288"/><polyline points="478,314 498,314"/><polyline points="478,340 498,340"/>
</g>
</g>
<!-- layer labels with leader lines -->
<g font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC">
<line x1="430" y1="70" x2="430" y2="150" stroke="#3e6aa8" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="300" y="34" width="260" height="44" rx="22" fill="#3e6aa8"/>
<text x="430" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">第一层：环境层（兜底）</text>

<line x1="604" y1="300" x2="640" y2="300" stroke="#3e6aa8" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="640" y="278" width="260" height="44" rx="22" fill="#5b8fd6"/>
<text x="770" y="308" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">第二层：模型层</text>

<line x1="330" y1="480" x2="360" y2="436" stroke="#3e6aa8" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="90" y="494" width="300" height="44" rx="22" fill="#4caf7d"/>
<text x="240" y="524" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">第三层：外部内容层</text>

<text x="430" y="120" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="#3e6aa8">容器 · 沙箱 · 虚拟机 · 白名单</text>
<text x="770" y="352" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="#3e6aa8">提示词 · 分类器 · 监控</text>
<text x="240" y="566" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="#2f6e4f">插件 · 网页 · 仓库文件</text>
</g>
<!-- side note -->
<g font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC">
<rect x="720" y="420" width="320" height="110" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#a9c2de" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="744" y="458" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#1c3a5e">核心结论</text>
<text x="744" y="492" font-size="20" fill="#3e5e82">三层缺一不可</text>
<text x="744" y="518" font-size="20" fill="#3e5e82">环境层才是最后防线</text>
</g>
</svg></body></html>
